description: This file defines callback functions for nghttp2 session events, such as frame handling, data transmission, and errors, used in HTTP/2 protocol implementation within the quiche project.

methods.name: OnReadyToSend
methods.description: Callback invoked when the session is ready to send data, calls visitor->OnReadyToSend and handles return codes.

methods.name: OnBeginFrame
methods.description: Called at the start of a frame, invokes visitor->OnFrameHeader and specific frame type handlers.

methods.name: OnFrameReceived
methods.description: Handles received frames, dispatching to visitor methods based on frame type.

methods.name: OnBeginHeaders
methods.description: Called at the start of headers, invokes visitor->OnBeginHeadersForStream.

methods.name: OnHeader
methods.description: Processes individual header fields, calls visitor->OnHeaderForStream.

methods.name: OnBeforeFrameSent
methods.description: Called before a frame is sent, logs and invokes visitor->OnBeforeFrameSent.

methods.name: OnFrameSent
methods.description: Called after a frame is sent, invokes visitor->OnFrameSent.

methods.name: OnFrameNotSent
methods.description: Handles failure to send a frame, calls source->OnFailure for extension frames.

methods.name: OnDataChunk
methods.description: Processes data chunks received on streams, calls visitor->OnDataForStream.

methods.name: OnExtensionChunkReceived
methods.description: Processes received extension frames, calls visitor->OnMetadataForStream.

methods.name: OnUnpackExtensionCallback
methods.description: Handles unpacking of extension frames, calls visitor->OnMetadataEndForStream.

methods.name: OnPackExtensionCallback
methods.description: Handles packing of extension frames, calls source->Pack.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and initializes nghttp2 session callbacks with the above functions.
